roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Reusable permission bundles you assign to users. The built-in Administrator, Viewer, and Staff roles can be re-permissioned but not renamed or deleted.
roles.confirmDelete: Delete role "{{name}}"? Users with this role will keep any per-user permissions but lose the role's.

receipt.title: Receipt printing
receipt.description: Configure the receipts printed for sales orders. Print a receipt from an order's detail panel on the Sales page — it's generated at the width set here so it prints on a thermal/roll printer without scaling.
receipt.footerPlaceholder: e.g. Thanks for your business! All sales final.
receipt.adminOnly: Only administrators can change receipt settings.

catalog.title: Catalog data
catalog.description: Refresh the per-game card catalogs, prices, and image hashes on the server. Magic comes from Scryfall; every other game comes from TCGCSV (TCGplayer data, refreshed daily). One job runs at a time.

languages.heading: Languages to download
languages.help: Download non-English printings too, so scans of foreign cards match their own art. English is always included. Changes apply on the next “Download catalog”; unticked languages are removed then.
languages.englishOnly: This game’s catalog source only provides English cards. Foreign copies can still be tagged with their language when scanning or editing.
languages.saved: Language selection saved — run “Download catalog” to apply it.
languages.mtgSizeWarning: Any non-English language switches MTG to Scryfall’s all-languages file (~400 MB download) and hashes each language’s art.
languages.pricesNote: Non-English cards rarely have their own prices; they’re valued at the English printing’s price (Pokémon Japan has real prices).

schedule.title: Automatic updates
schedule.description: Update the catalogs on a schedule. Card data adds new sets and printings (and hashes them for scanning); prices refresh market values. TCGCSV republishes once a day, so one run a day keeps everything current.
schedule.adminOnly: Only administrators can change the schedule.
schedule.timeZone: Times are in the server's time zone: {{zone}}.
schedule.noTimes: No times yet. Add at least one.
schedule.runNowHelp: Runs the selected games and updates now, even when the schedule is off.
schedule.runStarted: Update started. Progress shows under Recent above.
schedule.lastRunUnfinished: Last run started {{when}} and did not finish (the server stopped).
schedule.neverRun: No automatic update has run yet.

ebay.title: eBay
ebay.failed: eBay connection failed. Please try again.
ebay.misconfigured: eBay isn't configured on the server yet (AppId/CertId/RuName/AcceptUrl).
ebay.missingCredentialsBefore: The server is missing eBay app credentials: {{missing}}. Set the
ebay.missingCredentialsAfter: section in the server's appsettings, then reload.

selling.title: Seller settings
selling.description: The seller address and shipping/return preferences used by "Run seller setup" to create your eBay inventory location and business policies.
selling.addressRequired: eBay needs a complete address to create your inventory location. Fill in at least Address, City, Postal code and Country, then save and run seller setup.
selling.saved: Seller settings saved. Now click "Run seller setup" above.

sales.title: Sales
sales.description: When you mark a listing as picked, its card is automatically moved to this location. Leave it unset to disable picking.
sales.moveSwitch: Move picked cards to the for-sale location
sales.moveOn: Marking a listing as picked physically relocates the card to the for-sale location above.
sales.moveOff: Marking a listing as picked only changes its status — the card stays in its current location.
sales.allGamesSwitch: Order card search covers all games
sales.allGamesOn: Adding a card to an order searches listed cards of every game, whatever the game selector is set to. Applies to everyone who edits orders.
sales.allGamesOff: Adding a card to an order only searches listed cards of the game picked in the game selector.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Card preview size — how large the artwork popup grows when you hover a card in a list. 100% is the default; drag up to {{max}}%.

users.manageDescription: Accounts that can sign in. The built-in Admin account can't be deleted. People change their own email and password on their Account page.
users.systemDeleteTooltip: The system account can't be deleted
users.requireResetDescription: Their current password stops working straight away. Give them the setup key below. The next time they sign in, they enter it and choose a new password.
users.emailHelper: They can sign in with this instead of their username.
users.setupKeyHelper: Give this key to the user. They enter it the first time they sign in, then choose their own password.
users.setupKeyInvalid: Use {{min}}–{{max}} letters or numbers, with no spaces or symbols.
users.setupPendingTooltip: This user must sign in with their setup key and choose a password.
users.roleHelper: New users default to the Viewer role (view-only) if none is chosen.
users.grantHelper: Extra permissions this user gets beyond their role.
users.denyHelper: Permissions removed from this user even if their role grants them.

components.title: Components
components.description: Software and third-party components that OmniCard ships or runs on, with their versions and links to each project's website and license.

scanBadges.title: Scan badges
scanBadges.descriptionBefore: On the Scan page, matched cards show a gold
scanBadges.descriptionAfter: when the card isn't in your collection yet, and one to five currency signs indicating its value. Set the currency and the price ceiling for each tier below — a card at or below the first ceiling shows one sign; anything above the last ceiling shows five.
scanBadges.currencyHelper: Displayed as "{{symbol}}", localized to your browser.
scanBadges.ascendingWarning: Thresholds should increase from tier 1 to tier 4. They'll be sorted automatically when saved.
scanBadges.adminOnly: Only administrators can change these thresholds.

deckTypes.title: Deck types
deckTypes.description: The deck formats a deck box can be assigned, per game. Built-ins can be edited; add your own for formats we didn't include. Rules drive advisory legality warnings only — they never block.
deckTypes.basicLandsExempt: Basic lands exempt from copy limit
deckTypes.copiesByCollectorNumber: Count copies by card number (all arts of a number count as one card)
deckTypes.emptyState: No deck types for this game yet.
deckTypes.confirmDelete: Delete deck type "{{name}}"? Deck boxes using it will be unset.

sites.title: Sites
sites.description: A site is a MAJOR physical location — a home, a shop, a storage unit — that holds many storage locations (binders, boxes, deck boxes). Use sites when several people share this collection: each person only sees the sites they are allowed to. The Default site is always visible to everyone and holds every location not assigned elsewhere, including Bulk.
sites.whatIsASite: A site is a major physical place (for example "Andrew's House" or "The Shop"), not a shelf or a box. Locations are created inside a site.
sites.defaultAccessTooltip: The Default site is always visible to every user.
sites.defaultDeleteTooltip: The Default site can't be deleted.
sites.deleteHelp_one: This site has {{count}} location. It will be moved, with all of its cards, to the site you choose below.
sites.deleteHelp_other: This site has {{count}} locations. They will be moved, with all of their cards, to the site you choose below.
sites.accessHelp: Read lets someone browse and search this site's locations and cards (and add them to lists). Write also lets them change those locations and cards, subject to their normal permissions. A user gets the higher of their own and their role's level. Administrators always see every site.

scanFolders.title: Watched scan folders
scanFolders.description: Point each game at a folder on the server and save scans into a subfolder named after the batch. Each batch appears on the Scan page right away, but its files are left untouched in the folder until it starts: when someone presses Run, or by itself once its files stop changing for the quiet period. Then the files are moved to a _processed subfolder and matched in the background.
scanFolders.adminOnly: Only an administrator can change watched folders.
scanFolders.autoProcessHelp: When on, each batch starts by itself once its files have gone the quiet period without changing. Every batch has its own timer, so several can run at once. When off, batches wait on the Scan page until someone presses Run. Either way, files stay untouched in the folder until their batch starts.
scanFolders.deleteOriginals: Delete originals when a batch is closed
scanFolders.deleteOriginalsHelp: When a batch is committed or discarded, delete its original files from the folder's _processed subfolder. When off, they're kept there.
scanFolders.quietPeriodHelp: How long a batch's files must go unchanged (no new, renamed or growing files) before it starts by itself.
scanFolders.retentionHelp: Stored scans of committed or discarded batches are deleted after this many days.
scanFolders.iisHint: On IIS, set the app pool to AlwaysRunning with preload on, or folders are only watched while someone is using the site.

tagRules.title: Tag rules
tagRules.description: Tag cards automatically. Each rule is a search for one game: cards that match get the rule's tags when they're scanned (shown in scan review, where you can remove them) or imported. Use Run now to tag cards you already own. Rules only add tags; they never remove them.
tagRules.queryHelp: Uses the same search as the Collection page. Location, tags and prices can't be used in a rule.
tagRules.tagsHelp: Type a tag and press Enter. New tags are created when the rule first tags a card.
tagRules.enabledSwitch: Apply to new scans and imports
tagRules.previewEmpty: Enter a search to see which cards it matches.
tagRules.previewCounts: Matches {{matches}} cards; {{changes}} would get new tags.
tagRules.emptyState: No tag rules for this game yet.
tagRules.confirmDelete: Delete the tag rule "{{name}}"? Tags it already added stay on the cards.
tagRules.runConfirm_one: Add {{tags}} to {{formatted}} card you already own?
tagRules.runConfirm_other: Add {{tags}} to {{formatted}} cards you already own?
tagRules.runNothing: Every card this rule matches already has its tags. There's nothing to do.

reset.title: Reset collection
reset.description: Removes your whole collection so you can start over: every card and sealed lot, every storage location, binder and deck box, every site except Default, every card list, all trades, and all tags and tag rules. All sales data is kept: orders, customers, listings, and the history behind your sales and profit reports. Cards that are still listed for sale are kept too, along with their locations and tags.
reset.backupWarning: This can't be undone in OmniCard. Back up the OmniCard database first (in SSMS: Tasks ▸ Back Up). Restoring that backup is the only way to get your collection back. Game catalogs, users, roles, settings and saved scan images aren't touched.
reset.alwaysKept: Also kept: sales listings and their history, realized profit, users and roles, all settings, deck types, scan batches, game catalogs and downloaded card art.

counts.movements: Inventory history entries for unsold cards
counts.keptLocations: Locations (Bulk, plus any in use by listings or settings)

reset.failed: The reset failed. Nothing was changed.
reset.nothingToRemove: There's nothing to remove: the collection is already empty.
